description: Jordan is holding the family's inherited 16mm film projector and must decide how to arrange a one-night family screening, including the film, room, projector setup, and transport plan, after checking in with four relatives and friends.

shared_context.S1: The family inherited a working 16mm film projector and wants to hold one screening for relatives and close friends.
shared_context.S2: The community hall is available for the screening, with rooms A and B open for family events.
shared_context.S3: Jordan is keeping the projector and will make the final call about the screening plan.
shared_context.S4: The projector has to be carried from Jordan's apartment to the hall and returned afterward.
shared_context.S5: Jordan's usual practice is to go around the group and ask each person for relevant details before confirming a family plan.

PF1.text: Lena found a handwritten note from their grandmother saying that the projector's first family screening should be The Red Balloon; she has not shown the note to the group yet.

PF2.text: Omar checked the projector's model manual and recommends using a 500W ELC lamp, testing the projector before the screening, and keeping a spare lamp available; he has not shared those specifications with Jordan.

PF3.text: Priya confirmed with the hall manager that only room B has blackout curtains and a wall suitable for the projector screen; she has not yet passed that confirmation to Jordan.

PF4.text: Sam can transport the projector only in an upright padded crate, and he can bring that crate to Jordan's apartment at 17:30 on the screening day; he has not yet discussed this limitation with Jordan.

acceptance_conditions: The screening film must be The Red Balloon.
The screening must be held in room B.
The projector setup must specify a 500W ELC lamp.
The projector must be tested before the screening.
A spare lamp must be available for the screening.
The projector must be transported upright in a padded crate.
The transport commitment must specify 17:30 on the screening day.
Lena's grandmother's note must be cited as justification.

content_checks.C6: any(c['type'] == 'upright_crated_transport' and c['detail'] == '17:30 on screening day' for c in commitments)

decisive_facts.why: The grandmother's note changes the film choice from an open screening selection to the exact title The Red Balloon and supplies the fact Jordan must cite.
The manual and projection recommendation change the lamp choice to exactly 500W ELC, require a pre-screening test, and add the spare-lamp commitment.
The hall confirmation changes the room choice to room B and requires the matching room-booking commitment because only that room has suitable blackout and screen conditions.
Sam's transport limitation changes the handling plan to an upright padded crate and fixes the transport commitment's time at 17:30 on the screening day.
